blocks.text: Problem solving using computational thinking helps us solve problems in a logical and organized way. It helps reduce mistakes and confusion. Computational thinking improves overall problem-solving ability.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Computers solve problems in the way humans do when they use computational thinking, but much faster!
